name: curriculum
description: Curriculum and self-play. Drives self-improvement by selecting progressively harder tasks and generating training scenarios. The agent's internal teacher.

skill_inventory.description: Tracks the agent's proficiency across skill dimensions

task_generation.description: Generate tasks that are slightly beyond current ability -- hard enough to learn from, easy enough to not be hopeless

self_play.description: Agent generates problems for itself to solve, then evaluates its own solutions
